title: Life-Space Broad Spectrum Probiotic Advanced 90 Capsules $35 (RRP $73.99) + Delivery @ Amazon AU
body:
Deal: Life-Space Broad Spectrum Probiotic Advanced 90 Capsules $35 (RRP $73.99) + Delivery @ Amazon AU

[Lucille Bluth] RRP $73.99
It has never been this price on Amazon and average price since start of the year and since it's been on Amazon has been $43.86
[ATangk] Still ATL. And not like Chemist Warehouse ever sells at RRP.
[FLICKIT] Random-noob question… People often recommend taking probiotics for a couple of weeks before heading to Vietnam or Thailand to eat street-food, are these pill-form probiotics suitable or helpful for this purpose?
[Mr Mrrtn] I don't know the exact strains to recommend. However I've seen specific "travel probiotics" from reputable brands such as Innerhealth that are worth looking into.
Does it work? Hard to say, I'm sure it helps and may reduce change of getting gastro problems. Street foods are generally safe to eat, as long as you can see they've been cooked there and then, and if you want to be extra safe avoid anything that has been in contact with water and not cooked after (e.g. Salad) as water often harbours bacteria
[mad__llama] I can't comment about probiotics, but I can recommend that you investigate Travelan (from Chemist Warehouse) to take while you're over there, if only going for a few weeks holiday.
It's not super cheap and you do need to take it with every suspect meal, but I've yet to get sick after several trips to Thailand, and my relatives over there take us out to eat a lot…
[FLICKIT] I've noticed people recommending 'Travelan'… ty….
My gut is pretty good when it comes to chilli/garlic/spicey, or the likes, but I wonder about the greens, herbs, and such, being washed with local/tap/dodgy water and the likes.. I don't want to worry too much about what I eat (beyond the usual common-sense)…
If there's anything I can take to avoid bacteria or parasite issues, I'm keen, lol
[Elyxar] If you have a shellfish allergy avoid eating insects while there. They contain the same protein (tropomyosin) that shellfish have. A friend found out the hard way.
[overlook] Yea generally you do about 2 weeks before your trip to exotic countries to prevent severe gastro issue. The strain is sb Saccharomyces boulardii tho.
[warclone] the newer formula one is $34 from kogan or $37 from priceline pharmacy
